$note: Hand-written pages that must appear in sitemap.xml. Config only - never add content here. Each entry names a root-level .html file; scripts/build_index.py and scripts/build-index.mjs both read this file and emit `<loc>` for it ONLY when the file really exists on disk, so deleting a page without cleaning it up here is safe. Both builders must emit byte-identical output (ci.sh step 3 diffs them). priority is the sitemap <priority> string. Pages generated by build_content.py (hubs) or build_landing_pages.py (exam/topic/cluster pages) must NOT be listed - they are already registered through content-manifest.json and landing-manifest.json.
